agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, January 21, 2014 - 07:00 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
Print Agenda in PDF
January 21, 2014 Agenda (PDF)
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Councilmember Sanchez
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of a certificate of appointment to Bryan Mathews and Robert Eubanks (Parks and Recreation Commission)
Presentation of a plaque to outgoing Parks and Recreation Commissioner Candice Bergan.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Special City Council meeting, and Regular City Council Meeting held on January 6, 2014. RECOMMEND APPROVAL
Minutes- January 6, 2014 Regular Meeting
Minutes-January 6, 2014-Special Meeting
c.
Approval of Demands
Staff Report - item 7.C.
d.
Adoption of an Ordinance of the City of Lomita adopting by reference the 2013 Los Angeles County Building, Electrical, Plumbing, Mechanical, Residential and Green Building Standards Codes with certain amendments necessitated by local conditions. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff Report - item 7.D
e.
Consider authorizing the Mayor to sign a letter of support for Assembly Bill 1147 requiring massage establishments to post a notice at the place of business regarding human trafficking. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
Staff report- item 7.E
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO SIGN A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) FOR THE MEASURE R SOUTH BAY HIGHWAY PROGRAM FUND BETWEEN THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY METROPOLITAN TRANSPORTATION AUTHORITY (LACMTA) AND THE CITY OF LOMITA
Presented by Community Services Director McPherron.
Staff Report- item 8
9.
SOLAR POWER OPPORTUNITIES AT CITY FACILITIES
Discussion regarding the feasibility of installation of solar power installation at city facilities. Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano.
Staff Report- item 9
10.
DISCUSSION AND CONSIDERATION OF AN INTERIM ORDINANCE PROHIBITING SELF-STORAGE FACILITIES.
Presented by Assistant City Manager Sugano.
Staff Report- item 10
11.
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION TO STAFF REGARDING SIDEWALK AND STREET IMPROVEMENT ON WEST SIDE OF WALNUT STREET NORTH OF LOMITA BOULEVARD, AND SIDEWALK ON SOUTH SIDE OF 256TH STREET EAST OF WALNUT STREET.
Presented by Associate Engineer Shabazi.
Staff Report- item 11
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
